title: Basra Oil Company employees protest wages under BP contract
location: In front of BP building, Rumaila oil field, Basra.

date.summary: Kurdistan24 dates the demonstration to Dec3.

participants.summary: Article says dozens and large-scale, which does not establish >=50.

demands.summary: Demand concerns unpaid wages and enforcement of a BP–Basra Oil Company contract.

state_target.summary: No state-policy demand or appeal to government is described; the specific target is employer/contract enforcement.

exclusion_reason: Pending evidence does not establish threshold, and the stated grievance is company-contract/wages rather than a demand against state policy. Exclude unless new evidence supports both criteria.
